name: @cms/server
description: Apache-2.0 self-hosted Handoff CMS server. Node 22 ESM executable that wires @cms/api over a real @cms/storage Postgres instance, validates OIDC bearer tokens against a JWKS, enforces tenant/request/upload quotas, and emits PII-free structured JSON logs, /health/live, /health/ready, and Prometheus-format /metrics. No proprietary control-plane dependency in production.
